notes: Access: direct fetch worked with no blocking (Shopify storefront, robots.txt is generic 'User-agent: *' with no Claude/ClaudeBot-specific disallow group). site_url redirects to https://www.seletti.it/ (EU/Italy storefront, English UI); separate us.seletti.it and uk.seletti.it exist but are out of scope for this Italy-assigned row. All qty verified via exhaustion-paging /collections/<handle>/products.json (Rule 1), not the inflated collections.json metadata field (which differed by 1-5 units on several collections, e.g. plates-1 metadata=96 vs verified=95, vases metadata=91 vs verified=87, wall-mirrors metadata=45 vs verified=44). Rule 0.6 overlaps: (1) 'Terracotta' (Objects nav) and 'Terracotta Vases & Ornaments' (Outdoor nav, handle outdoor-lighitng) are a byte-for-byte identical 48-product set under two URLs -- kept only 'Terracotta', dropped the Outdoor duplicate. (2) 'Tableware Outdoor' (40) overlaps ~24 products with Bowls/Plates/Trays but is a genuine use-case cross-cut (melamine picnic sets, distinct SKUs), not a pure duplicate -- kept both per the type-tree+room-tree pattern. (3) 'Ashtray' (6) overlaps 4 products with 'Terracotta' (Magna Graecia line) -- kept both, both are legitimate merchandising nodes. (4) 'Photo Frames' (4) overlaps 2 dual-purpose mirror/frame products with 'Small Mirrors' (19) -- kept both. 'Soap Dish' nav item (handle brain-wash-seletti-x-propaganda, 4 products) is a literal duplicate subset of 4 products already inside 'Home Accessories'/memorabilia -- dropped as duplicate, not listed separately. Manual scope filter: 'Home Accessories' (memorabilia) collection reports 52 products but contains 2 hot-water bottles and 2 consumable soap bars mixed into an otherwise sculptural/decorative line (busts, skulls, Wunderkammer/Memorabilia figurines) -- excluded those 4 non-decor SKUs per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad', qty=48 verified by title inspection of the full product list. Excluded as out of scope: Cutlery (kitchen cutlery), Candles (confirmed 'scented candle' / fragrance wording in product descriptions -- Home Fragrance exclusion), Cases (wash bags/pouches/beauty cases/laptop bags -- travel accessories, not decor), Dustbin (functional waste bin, storage-adjacent), Mats (bath/floor mats made of recycled plastic bottles -- textile/rug-adjacent), Notebooks (stationery), Thermal Bottles and Travel (functional drinkware/travel gear), Textiles/Dondi x Seletti (fabric + designer collab), all Furniture proper (Armchairs, Bed, Bench, Cabinets, Chairs, Curtains, Cushions, Deckchairs, Folding Chairs, Hangers, Modular Pouf, Nightstand, Poolbeds, Pouf, Shelf, Side Table, Sofas, Stool, Rugs, Tables -- only Wall Mirrors was pulled out per Rule 0.3), Outdoor Table and Chairs, Deckchairs & Poolbeds, Shower/aquart-shower (bathroom fixture), 'Collectibles'/Limited Edition (54-product marketing roll-up spanning mugs/plates/glasses/mirrors/lamps/rugs/cushions/cases -- mixed cross-category roll-up, not a genuine product type, dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad'), designer/brand collab collections (Codalunga x Seletti, Gianpiero x Seletti, Love Is A Verb/Tatiana Brodatch, Alessandro Malossi x Seletti, Marcantonio x Seletti/Innerglow, Propaganda x Seletti) per NEVER-EXTRACT brand/designer listing rule, Sunglasses/Jewelry/Beauty/Pets/Spare Parts (non-decor categories), Christmas (Holiday), 'Products'/'Gifts' (1405 and 1720-product Shop-All roll-ups), price-band facets (Under 50/50-100/100-200/Over 200), New Arrival, Sales, Best Seller.
